item.title: Danger in the Jungle: Navigating the Chaos w. Healthy Families & Better Stories ft. Jason Weening [Open Mike with Michael Thiessen]
item.description:
OPEN MIKE w/Michael Thiessen ~ November 08, 2024
In this episode of Open Mike, Dr. Michael Thiessen engages with author Jason Weening about his new book, Danger in the Jungle. They discuss the importance of family integration in education, the role of mentorship, and the need for literature that reflects a Christian worldview. Weening shares his motivations for writing the book, which aims to engage young readers through adventure and relatable themes. The conversation also touches on the challenges of getting Christian literature into public schools and the courage required to navigate parenting and education in today's culture.
